name: Level_1 - Task_1
description: Generate a finite-temperature molecular dynamics trajectory for bulk Silver (Ag). Construct a conventional face-centered cubic (FCC) unit cell of Silver (a = 4.09 Å) and replicate it into a 4 × 4 × 4 supercell. The MACE-MP-0 foundation model should be used as the ASE-compatible calculator to describe interatomic interactions. Conduct molecular dynamics simulations in the canonical (NVT) ensemble using a Langevin thermostat at a target temperature of 300 K with a 1.0 fs timestep and a friction coefficient of 0.01 fs⁻¹. Execute the simulation for 5,000 steps, recording the atomic configuration to an ASE trajectory file every 100 steps. Return the absolute path to the resulting trajectory file as a string. Save momenta, potential energy and forces from the MACE calculator in every trajectory frame. Set each frame's atoms.info fields step (cumulative MD step), time_fs (step times 1.0 fs), thermostat ("Langevin"), and model ("MACE-MP-0"). The initial frame at step zero (or the start of production) is optional; include the final step. Also store friction_fs = 0.01 in atoms.info.
submission_format: string representing the absolute path to the output file (eg. '/path/to/trajectory.traj')
